resources.title: Django Tutorial Part 8: User authentication and permissions
resources.why: Start here: a guided tutorial on Django users, logging in and showing each user only their own records.

resources.title: Using the Django authentication system: creating users
resources.why: Shows User.objects.create_user, which stores a hashed password instead of the plain text one.

resources.title: Making queries
resources.why: Covers filter(), exists(), create() and lookups like __iexact, which you use to check usernames and fetch a user's notes.

resources.title: Password management in Django
resources.why: Explains how Django hashes and checks passwords, so you understand why you never save them yourself.

resources.title: A01 Broken Access Control (OWASP Top 10:2025)
resources.why: Why returning another user's data is the number one web security risk, and how filtering by owner prevents it.
